query="Hanes Men's ComfortSoft Short Sleeve T-Shirt"

colors_to_try=["red","black","navy blue"]
results_by_color={}

# Use existing amazon_token
amazon_token=globals()['amazon_token']

for color in colors_to_try:
    all_products=[]
    page=0
    while True:
        page_res=apis.amazon.search_products(query=query, color=color, relative_size='extra-large', page_index=page, page_limit=20, sort_by='-rating')
        items=page_res if isinstance(page_res, list) else []
        # If API returns failure schema? It would be dict with message; handle
        if isinstance(page_res, dict) and 'message' in page_res:
            print('search failure', color, page_res)
            items=[]
        if not items:
            break
        all_products.extend(items)
        print('color', color, 'page', page, 'items', len(items))
        page+=1
        if page>50:
            break
    results_by_color[color]=all_products
    print('color', color, 'total_products', len(all_products))

# Summarize inventory>0 candidates per color
for color, prods in results_by_color.items():
    avail=[p for p in prods if p.get('inventory_quantity',0)>0]
    # gather top few
    print('color', color, 'available_count', len(avail))
    if avail:
        # sort by rating desc then price asc then delivery_days asc
        avail_sorted=sorted(avail, key=lambda p:(-p.get('rating',0), p.get('price',0), p.get('delivery_days',0)))
        top=avail_sorted[:5]
        print('top5', [(p['product_id'], p['color'], p['relative_size'], p.get('rating'), p.get('price'), p.get('delivery_days'), p.get('inventory_quantity')) for p in top])

arguments.code:
# Find Hanes Men's ComfortSoft Short Sleeve T-Shirt candidates by color and inventory >=2
candidates={}
for color, prods in results_by_color.items():
    hanes=[p for p in prods if p.get('product_type')=='t-shirt' and p.get('name')=="Hanes Men's ComfortSoft Short Sleeve T-Shirt"]
    candidates[color]=hanes
    inv2=[p for p in hanes if p.get('inventory_quantity',0)>=2]
    print('color', color, 'hanes_count', len(hanes), 'inv>=2_count', len(inv2))
    print('hanes', [(p['product_id'], p.get('relative_size'), p.get('color'), p.get('rating'), p.get('price'), p.get('inventory_quantity')) for p in hanes])

# choose preferred color with inv>=2
preferred_order=['red','black','navy blue']
chosen_color=None
for c in preferred_order:
    if any(p.get('inventory_quantity',0)>=2 for p in candidates.get(c, [])):
        chosen_color=c
        break
print('chosen_color', chosen_color)

if chosen_color:
    # pick listing with highest rating then lowest price
    inv2=[p for p in candidates[chosen_color] if p.get('inventory_quantity',0)>=2]
    inv2_sorted=sorted(inv2, key=lambda p:(-p.get('rating',0), p.get('price',0), p.get('product_id',0)))
    chosen_product=inv2_sorted[0]
    print('chosen_product', {k:chosen_product.get(k) for k in ['product_id','name','color','relative_size','rating','price','inventory_quantity']})
else:
    print('No color has inventory>=2')
